description: Google's first-generation text embedding model for the Gemini API. Provides general-purpose embeddings for semantic similarity and retrieval tasks. This model has been superseded by text-embedding-004.

trainingData.description: Trained on diverse text data. Specific training data composition is proprietary.

trainingProcedure: Contrastive learning techniques. Specific methodology is proprietary.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Solid baseline performance. Superseded by text-embedding-004 with improved retrieval accuracy.
